case_number: 2023 INSC 822; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 2741 OF 2023; SLP(CRL.) NO(S). 4927 OF 2023

parties.respondent: M.P. State Industrial Development Corporation Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Suspension of sentence under Section 389 CrPC in cheque dishonor cases; purposive interpretation of Section 148 NI Act; 'may' in section to be read as 'shall' unless exceptional circumstances; mandatory 20% deposit exception requires specific reasons; High Court's mechanical application set aside; courts erroneously treated 20% deposit as absolute rule.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
Section 148 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
Section 389 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned High Court orders set aside; revision petitions restored for reconsideration on 20% deposit condition; interim suspension continues pending High Court decision.
